$comment: One run of the scripted generation pipeline (docs/generation-flow.md) on a fixed prompt, used as the baseline for later phases of the pipeline work. It measures the Phase 1 flow (honest validate, typecheck gate, docs/compact-gotchas.md + docs/patterns.md context budget), not the flow before Phase 1. Re-run the same prompt after each phase and add a run below.
prompt: Build a private tip jar: people can leave tips for the jar's owner without revealing who tipped how much, and only the owner can withdraw.
scope: Steps 1-4: name and flags, new:example, contract + witnesses + tests, compile/typecheck, yarn validate. No UI.

runs.model: claude-opus-5-5, one general-purpose subagent given only the prompt and the flow doc

contracts: tip-token.compact (demo faucet so tests have shielded coins)

notes: typecheck: run before the tests were written; the scaffold's deployContract call lacked the new constructor argument. Phase 2's --derive would generate it.

largestReads: examples/shielded-chips/src/test/roulette.test.ts (32 KB, read in full: no 'Your tests begin here' marker)
beyondBudget: shielded-chips src/wallet.ts (splitShieldedCoin) and src/providers.ts: the template harness has no shielded self-transfer
context.notRead: LESSONS.md, TUTORIAL.md, midnight-expert skills, SDK sources
context.comparison: The pre-Phase-1 step 3 reading list was about 330 KB.

reviewNotes: Tip amounts are public (each pot entry is a full QualifiedShieldedCoinInfo); documented as an accepted leak. Who tipped is not recorded.

reNonceToSelf spends the same-transaction coin with sendShielded and mt_index 0, copied from shielded-chips roulette. docs/compact-gotchas.md (from the shielded-chips TUTORIAL) says same-transaction coins should use sendImmediateShielded. Both contracts pass on the devnet; worth a reviewer's eye.
Negative check of the new validate on this example: one broken assertion made yarn validate exit 1 at test:local, write logs/compose.log and tear the network down.
phase2And3Signals: A shielded self-transfer helper and a shielded test faucet had to be ported or written by hand; candidates for packages/ or the template.
Test files without the 'Your tests begin here' marker are read in full; adding it to every example's test would cut the largest read.
Context read (~125 KB) is still dominated by one large reference test; patterns.md could point at narrower test slices.
